label: D Flip-Flop (rising edge)

semantics.notes: Q captures D on rising CLK edge. Q is stable between edges. prevClk is an internal implementation detail stored in customState â€” it is NOT a user-visible state key. stateKeys=['q'] is the default. evaluate() always reads state.q regardless of current inputs; stateUpdate() implements the edge detection by comparing clk to prevClk.

exportSupport.verilogNotes: always @(posedge clk) begin q <= d; end; assign q_n = ~q; â€” q declared as reg, q_n declared as wire (verilogWireOutputs=['q_n']).
exportSupport.vhdlNotes: process(clk) begin if rising_edge(clk) then q <= d; end if; end process; q_n <= not q;

risks.description: No defaultInputValues â€” D and CLK default to 0. Safe for CLK, but D=0 at start means initialstate Q=0 at first rising edge even if no D was ever driven.
No setup/hold violation detection in basic engine mode. Race condition detector in GATE_DELAY mode uses clockInputId='clk' to flag setup_hold_risk.
